name: Decline Machine Chest Press
description: The Decline Machine Chest Press performs a chest press movement at a downward angle, targeting the sternal and lower fibers of the pectoralis major. The machine provides a guided bar path, and the decline angle increases the mechanical emphasis on the lower chest region compared to flat or incline pressing variations.

execution.starting_position: Sit in the decline machine with the seat adjusted so handles are at lower chest level. Secure feet if the machine provides ankle support.
execution.setup_instructions: Adjust the seat height and handle depth. The machine should guide the press in a downward-angled path relative to the user's torso.
steps: Step 1: Grip the handles at lower chest level.
Step 2: Press forward and downward along the machine's guided path to full extension.
Step 3: Return under control to the starting position.
Step 4: Repeat for the prescribed reps.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on the press. Inhale on the return.
common_mistakes: Seat height set incorrectly so the press does not target the lower chest
safety_considerations: Secure feet in the ankle holds if provided — especially important at a decline angle
Adjust weight incrementally — machine weight stacks feel different from free weights at decline angles
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full extension at the front; full return to deep stretch without discomfort.
coaching_cues: Press downward and outward to feel the lower chest working
